revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v3.0 BERT 99.9 Server
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v3.0 BERT high-accuracy Server configuration, verify BERT 99.9 accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure latency-valid Server queries per second, and compare with a signed comparable v3.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact SUT/GPU topology, driver/runtime, v3.0 container/harness commit, BERT model, SQuAD data/preprocessing/calibration and configs.
revision_candidate.target_scope: BERT 99.9 high_accuracy Server only across the declared resources. Offline and normal-accuracy 99 are excluded. Machine Time 600 and Attended Time 90 require a signed phase map.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Pinned v3.0 harness/container; licensed model/SQuAD/preprocessing/calibration hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; 600-minute phase map; Server QPS/latency and accuracy criteria; comparable result ID; tuning/thermal/power/recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify hashes/configs and baseline health, then run BERT 99.9 accuracy, Server performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v3.0 implementation specifies. Preserve SQuAD preprocessing, full LoadGen logs, latency validity, phase timing and telemetry.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Artifacts licensed/pinned; GPUs healthy; adequate resources; tuning/load/recovery approved; reference and phase plan signed.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU identity; all hashes/configs; SQuAD/calibration manifest; exact commands/timing; BERT 99.9 accuracy; complete LoadGen logs, valid Server QPS/latency; compliance; power/thermal/XID/ECC/host logs; named reference and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v3.0 BERT 99.9 Server rules and comparable result. Pass requires high-accuracy validity, Server latency-valid LoadGen/compliance, numeric QPS comparison and clean health.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix 99/99.9, Server/Offline or releases; use unlicensed data; alter preprocessing/tuning without approval; clear logs; suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/platform owners approve artifacts, reference, 600-minute plan and load; human judges comparability.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans sign acceptance/phase plan; Agent runs only the frozen workflow.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity/limits, preserve evidence, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify health before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing artifacts/reference/phase plan; wrong profile; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology drift; memory/storage/XID/ECC/thermal/power/host limit; evidence loss.
